assessments.title: Week 5 function reasoning check
assessments.instructions: Independently show reasoning for four items (5 points each). 1: Decide whether {(1,2),(2,2),(1,3)} is a function and explain. 2: For f(x)=3x−5, evaluate f(−2). 3: State the real domain of g(x)=7/(x+4). 4: A shuttle has 16 seats and charges $9 per rider. Define a feasible domain and compute R(7).

rubricCriteria.label: Function definition and counterexample
rubricCriteria.description: Correct classification supported by unique-output reasoning.

rubricCriteria.label: Algebraic domain
rubricCriteria.description: Valid restriction justified by undefined arithmetic.

rubricCriteria.label: Feasible domain and output
rubricCriteria.description: Whole-number input constraint, capacity and correct units.

assessments.title: Week 5 independent mastery and transfer
assessments.instructions: Work independently (5 points each). 1: Classify {(−1,4),(0,4),(2,4)} as a function and justify. 2: For h(t)=t²−2t, evaluate h(−3). 3: Find the real domain of q(x)=√(x−6). 4: A tank contains 30 liters and drains 3 liters/minute. Give the feasible domain of V(t)=30−3t and evaluate V(4), including units.

rubricCriteria.label: Function evaluation
rubricCriteria.description: Correct substitution and order of operations.

rubricCriteria.label: Real-valued radical domain
rubricCriteria.description: Correct radicand condition and boundary inclusion.

rubricCriteria.label: Contextual domain and evaluation
rubricCriteria.description: Correct continuous-time interval, endpoint and volume units.
